purpose: Example O5.5 trace for repeated Ohio selection in a controlled weak-item state.
caveat: This explains the current decision path; it does not prove the planner is pedagogically correct.

eligible.note: The item is present in the emitted plan.

reasonCode.source: membership in emitted U.S. Memory Trail plan arrays
reasonCode.note: The U.S. planner does not persist a separate reason code.

reason.value: Selected through the weak-review plan bucket.

whyWon.note: The U.S. planner does not retain rejected alternatives or comparison results.

randomSource.note: No explicit random function was supplied.
No explicit random function was supplied; a seed may still control randomness.

selectionReasons.source: U.S. Memory Trail plan membership and existing progress fields

reasonBucket.source: membership in emitted U.S. Memory Trail plan arrays

priorityFactors.source: existing U.S. Memory Trail progress and priority predicates

eligibleCandidateCount.source: existing U.S. Memory Trail eligibility and priority helpers
eligibleCandidateCount.note: Reconstructed read-only from the same state, plan, and deterministic context.

candidatePoolMetadata.source: existing U.S. Memory Trail plan and candidate projection

alternatives.source: existing U.S. Memory Trail eligibility and priority helpers
alternatives.note: Candidates were reconstructed without changing or rerunning selection.

value.exactComparatorSteps: The planner uses ordered comparator clauses but does not retain which clause broke each pairwise tie.
value.numericScore: No single selection score is calculated by the current planner.
value.crossBucketCompetition: New, weak, older, and recent slots are selected separately; they are not one shared ranked pool.
